value.title: Dumbbell Squat set 1
value.note: Front-racked pair of 30s (elbows out, palms forward, DBs on front delts). Limiter was LOWER BACK, not legs: heels lifted at the bottom, forcing a forward pitch. Root cause = ankle dorsiflexion restriction, not strength. Retest heel-elevated.

value.title: Farmer's Carry set 1
value.note: 2 trips, pair of 30s (60 lb total), ~45s each; included a flight of stairs up and down. RPE 4 — grip was NOT the limiter, so 60 lb is sub-threshold. Progress via load, duration, or the suitcase (one-sided) variant to target the glute med limiter found today.

value.title: Goblet Bulgarian Split Squat set 1
value.note: 12 total (6/side), held at 20 rather than the prescribed 20->25 jump: 22 days without loading (see #16062). Longer front-foot stance to reduce ankle dorsiflexion demand.

value.title: Goblet Bulgarian Split Squat set 2
value.note: Set 2. LIMITER = RIGHT KNEE, peri-patellar (around the kneecap), NOT muscular. Right is his more restricted side (tighter R hamstring, lower R SLR). Ended loaded lunge work for the day; rear lunge skipped as same-pattern knee load. Follow up on sensation quality + swelling.

value.title: Goblet Squat set 2
value.note: 3s eccentric + 1s pause tempo. Limiting factor was ARMS/hold, not legs — goblet position caps leg loading via anterior hold fatigue.

value.title: Single Leg Glute Bridge set 1
value.note: 20 total (10/side), bodyweight, 2s top hold. Limiter = LATERAL HIP STABILIZERS (glute medius) on the working side, not glute max. Relevant to squat instability and to unilateral load tolerance.

value.title: Dumbbell Rear Lunge set 1
value.note: 20 total (10/leg), 20lb pair — bumped from 15lb pair @ same RPE5 on 6/24. Progression stuck cleanly; load landed, still room. Side-DB hold keeps arms out → legs are the limiter.

value.title: Goblet Bulgarian Split Squat set 1
value.note: 16 total (8/leg), 20lb goblet — L RPE6 / R RPE8, RIGHT balance-limited. EXACT match to 6/24 (L6/R8). The day's peak/edge-finder; right side remains his weaker/tighter/less-stable link (lines up with right-hamstring-tighter + right-tighter forward fold). Upright goblet hold spared the sore low back.

value.title: Goblet Squat set 1

value.title: Romanian Deadlift set 1
value.note: Accidental 20 (meant 10), 20lb pair. LOW-BACK is the limiter again (consistent) — back a bit sore but explicitly NOT strained. Held position through 20 reps. Stop adding hinge volume from here; pivot to upright unilateral + back-friendly posterior to spare the low back.

value.title: Single Leg Glute Bridge set 1
